name: OpenFeature
solves: Provides a vendor-neutral OpenFeature SDK for Node and web so application code evaluates flags through a standard API while providers (LaunchDarkly, Unleash, flagd, etc.) remain swappable behind the interface.
best_for: Platforms that must avoid hard-wiring a single feature-flag vendor into application code
Enterprises standardizing flag evaluation behind OpenFeature providers across services
Teams mid-migration between flag vendors who need a stable application API
Organizations adopting CNCF OpenFeature as a governance requirement
Polyglot estates where OpenFeature is the common abstraction
skip_when: You want an all-in-one flags+analytics product and are happy locking to PostHog/GrowthBook APIs
You need a single SDK with built-in UI and experimentation — OpenFeature is an abstraction, not a platform
A simple env-based toggle is enough and provider wiring is overhead
Your chosen vendor's native SDK is required for advanced features not exposed via the provider
You are prototyping quickly and vendor neutrality is not a near-term concern
